faces.name: Alhammarret's Archive

abilities.text: If you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead.

with.reason: A draw replacement cannot carry the printed exception "except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps": WouldDraw offers only firstEachTurn, which is "the first card drawn each turn" and not the first draw of each draw step, and the exceptFirstInDrawStep field exists only on the Draws trigger, which watches a draw rather than replacing it.
with.text: If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.

abilities.text: If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
